sources_inspected.label: Midland Central Appraisal District Mineral Property page (accessed 2026-08-29)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current official Midland CAD page supplies the contractor statement, stated mineral-property scope, three named approach labels, and sufficient-data condition.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The page does not identify an account-specific method, data-sufficiency result, input, reconciliation, appraisal accuracy, ownership, title, tax, protest, sale value, offer, production, royalty, transaction, or legal conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Midland Central Appraisal District Publications page (accessed 2026-08-29)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current official Publications page separately lists annual reports, mass appraisal reports, reappraisal plans, and other documents.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: A listing does not import a report into the Mineral Property page or validate an account, appraisal, title, tax, sale value, or transaction result.

sources_inspected.label: Midland Central Appraisal District Open Records page (accessed 2026-08-29)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current official Open Records page separately lists certified and preliminary rolls, notices, and mineral files.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: A listed file does not prove ownership, title, account-level method, appraisal validity, tax liability, private sale value, or another property-specific conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Comptroller Midland county directory (accessed 2026-08-29)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Texas Comptroller directory supplies current issuer-routing evidence for Midland Central Appraisal District and midcad.org.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: Directory provenance does not endorse every district statement or validate a contract, account, appraisal, tax, title, or transaction result.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Comptroller Valuing Property page (accessed 2026-08-29)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Texas Comptroller page supplies current statewide context for common appraisal approaches, appraisal districts, and mass appraisal.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: Statewide context does not determine the approach, data sufficiency, input, result, or private transaction value for a Midland mineral account.
